name: how-it-works
description: Numbered steps section showing a process flow with icons, descriptions, and optional code snippets

ai.whenToUse: Use to explain a multi-step process like onboarding, setup, or workflow. Great for SaaS products, developer tools, and any product with a clear getting-started flow.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use for generic feature lists — use features-grid instead. Avoid if your process has more than 5 steps (too dense).
